known.via: English Wikipedia "Vallée de la Marne" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Champagne sub-region along the Marne, with more variable soils than the other sub-regions. Meunier is the main grape, about 59% of production, with 23% Pinot Noir and 18% Chardonnay. It has only two Grands Crus villages, Aÿ and Tours-sur-Marne.
